_note: SYNTHETIC test set written by the team (not real guests). Sentences were written separately from the topic examples in src/topics.js, but by the same people, so scores may be optimistic. Real guest feedback should be collected (with consent) to replace this.

topics.text: Roasting the beans over the fire was my favourite part.
The fresh cup of coffee at the end tasted amazing.
I finally understood how a coffee cherry becomes a drink.
Pounding the coffee in the wooden mortar was great fun.
The coffee was too bitter for me.
The path down to the waterfall was beautiful.
We loved seeing Kilimanjaro from the farm.
Walking under the banana trees was peaceful.
The trail was muddy and slippery after the rain.
The hike back up was exhausting for my parents.
Lunch was the best meal of our whole trip.
The stew with plantains was delicious.
Trying the banana beer was a fun surprise.
There was nothing for vegetarians to eat.
The portions at lunch were too small.
Noor and her family made us feel very welcome.
The stories about the grandparents were moving.
The family sang for us while we worked.
Everyone was so kind and patient with the children.
Our host seemed tired and did not talk much.
The guide explained each step very clearly.
We did not understand much because nobody translated.
I wish someone had explained the history of the farm.
The explanation of the drying process was really interesting.
Without a shared language it was hard to ask questions.
The tour was good value for the price.
It felt expensive compared to other tours.
Paying with mobile money was easy.
We were surprised by extra fees at the end.
The road up from Moshi was full of holes.
Our driver got lost looking for the farm.
There were no signs showing the way.
Getting there by motorbike was an adventure.
The toilet needs to be cleaner.
There was nowhere to wash our hands before lunch.
We needed more shade and somewhere to sit.
The bathroom was clean and simple.
I would happily have bought a bag of beans.
Please sell your coffee so visitors can take it home.
We bought two packets of roasted coffee as gifts.
It would be nice to buy some souvenirs from the village.
The visit was over far too quickly.
We waited almost an hour before starting.
Three hours was just the right length.
The afternoon felt rushed at the end.
My sister lives in Canada.
We are flying home on Tuesday.
I lost my sunglasses somewhere.

it.src: Il caffè era buonissimo e la famiglia molto gentile.
it.ref: The coffee was very good and the family very kind.

it.src: La strada per arrivare alla fattoria era difficile.
it.ref: The road to get to the farm was difficult.

it.src: Vorrei comprare del caffè da portare a casa.
it.ref: I would like to buy some coffee to take home.

it.src: Il bagno dovrebbe essere più pulito.
Abbiamo adorato la passeggiata fino alla cascata.
it.ref: We loved the walk to the waterfall.

fr.src: Le café était délicieux et la famille très accueillante.
fr.ref: The coffee was delicious and the family very welcoming.

fr.src: Le chemin était glissant après la pluie.
fr.ref: The path was slippery after the rain.

fr.src: Nous aurions aimé acheter du café torréfié.
fr.ref: We would have liked to buy roasted coffee.

de.src: Das Rösten der Kaffeebohnen hat uns sehr gefallen.
de.ref: We really enjoyed roasting the coffee beans.

de.src: Der Weg zur Farm war schwer zu finden.
de.ref: The way to the farm was hard to find.

de.src: Wir hätten gern Kaffee zum Mitnehmen gekauft.
de.ref: We would have liked to buy coffee to take away.

de.src: Die Erklärungen waren klar und interessant.
de.ref: The explanations were clear and interesting.

zh.src: 咖啡非常好喝，主人一家很热情。
zh.ref: The coffee was very good and the host family was very warm.
The road to the farm was hard to travel.

zh.src: 我们想买一些咖啡豆带回家。
zh.ref: We wanted to buy some coffee beans to take home.

es.src: Nos encantó tostar el café con la familia.
es.ref: We loved roasting the coffee with the family.

es.src: El camino estaba lleno de barro.
es.ref: The path was full of mud.

es.src: Nos gustaría comprar café para llevar a casa.
es.ref: We would like to buy coffee to take home.

pl.src: Kawa była pyszna, a rodzina bardzo gościnna.
pl.ref: The coffee was delicious and the family very hospitable.
The road to the farm was difficult.
We would like to buy coffee for home.
The walk to the waterfall was beautiful.
